title: Release Forecast Convergence — Ops Playbook
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, operational playbook to converge multiple product roadmap strands and KPIs into a single release forecast and go/no-go decision cadence. Target audience: product-ops, release leads, eng PMs, and SRE partners.

Status & context:
- Current release bucket: R1.5 (feature-complete gating targeted for week 6).
- This doc synthesizes weekly KPIs, risk triggers, and contingency actions for the next 8 weeks.
- Not final — use as the canonical working checklist for cross-functional standups until we publish a final runbook.

How to use this doc (quick):
1) Update the KPI snapshot each Wednesday after the weekly metrics pull.
2) If any trigger threshold is hit, page the responsible owner and add a red flag to the dashboard.
3) The release steward decides canary scope using the rollout decision matrix below.

Key gates and KPI thresholds (operational):
- User-visible latency (p95): Green < 250ms, Amber 250–400ms, Red > 400ms.
- Error rate (5xx) global: Green < 0.2%, Amber 0.2–0.75%, Red > 0.75%.
- Token cost delta vs baseline: Green <= +5%, Amber +5–+15%, Red > +15%.
- Regression in top-10 prompts pass rate (quality eval): Green >= 98%, Amber 95–98%, Red < 95%.
- Adoption funnel (beta orgs) weekly retention: Green >= 70%, Amber 50–70%, Red < 50%.

Quick decision matrix (when a Red appears):
- If single Red in non-blocking KPI (e.g., token cost) -> task force within 24h, continue with canary but restrict traffic.
- If latency or error-rate Red -> immediate rollback to previous stable model variant OR shift traffic to Dedicated pool; page SRE.
- If quality eval Red -> pause feature rollout and trigger prompt/patch evaluation window (48–72h).

Weekly cadence (operational checklist):
- Monday: final engineering triage on outstanding bugs blocking feature completion (owner: ENG PM).
- Wednesday: KPI snapshot publish and product-ops review (owner: Priya). Attach artifacts: perf-runbook, eval-results.csv, canary-plan.md.
- Friday: readiness sync — cross-functional go/no-go recommendation drafted for Exec Review.

Roadmap convergence table (single-line slices for quick scan):
- Feature set A: owner Lydia Park — behind by 2 dev days (integration test flakiness). Blocker: STORAGE-882.
- Feature set B: owner Evan Morales — on track, needs one more perf tune.
- Infra rollout (canary infra): owner Samir Patel — infra slots reserved Wk5–Wk7.

Contingency playbook (actionable snippets):
- Contingency 1: High token-cost inflation (> +15%)
  - Actions: 1) Apply lightweight quantized variant to non-critical routes. 2) Enable prefix-cache for top 3 routes. 3) Notify finance and update forecast. (owners: infra + finance)
- Contingency 2: Spike in 5xx errors
  - Actions: 1) Throttle suspicious client keys via rate limit policy; 2) Shift canary to dedicated pool; 3) Run quick heap/cgroup checks and restart affected service. (owners: SRE + infra)
- Contingency 3: Quality regression on top prompts
  - Actions: 1) Re-evaluate prompt set with regression harness; 2) Roll back to previous model variant for affected customers; 3) Kick off latent QA and human review. (owners: applied-ml + product)

Unresolved questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Need final SLA wording for canary customers. Who on legal to loop in? @Avery.
- Confirm whether Dedicated fallback incurs additional billing for customers during rollback scenario. Follow-up with finance.
- Decide canonical storage location for rolling eval artifacts (confluence vs s3).

Runbook snippets to copy into incident playbooks:
- If p95 latency > 600ms for > 15 minutes: immediate canary pause and fallback to earlier commit. Run "perf-rollback.sh" and notify #oncall-sre.
- If quality eval delta > 5% drop: mark release stage as "hold" and create a hotfix branch; apply minimal prompt-level mitigations.

Launch scope and phased rollout plan (short):
- Phase 0 (internal): SRE + QA smoke (0 users).
- Phase 1 (canary): 1–3 beta customers, 1% traffic. Monitor core KPIs for 72h.
- Phase 2 (ramped): 3–10 beta customers, 5–25% traffic depending on KPI health.
- Phase 3 (general): full roll when all KPIs green for 7 consecutive days.

Communication templates (copy/paste)
- Ops alert (when amber -> red triggered):
  Subject: [Release R1.5] KPI ALERT — <KPI_NAME> at <CURRENT_VALUE>
  Body: Quick summary; owners; immediate actions taken; current mitigation; ETA for next update.

- Customer-facing rollback note (short):
  "We're pausing the rollout of feature X to ensure stable performance for you. You will remain on the previous version while we investigate. Expected ETA: 24–48 hours."

Metrics snapshot (example format to paste into dashboard):
  date,p95_latency_ms,error_rate_pct,token_cost_delta_pct,eval_pass_pct,beta_retention_pct
  2025-01-10,220,0.12,3.4,98.9,74

Notes on measurements and caveats:
- Token cost measurement is noisy over short windows — use 7-day rolling average for decisions.
- Eval harness currently focuses on top-50 prompts; need to extend to long-tail prompts before full rollout.
- Some metrics are region-specific; always check region-filtered KPIs for the region being rolled out.

After-action and handover checklist (post-release):
- Export final KPI runbook and attach to release Confluence page.
- Rotate any temporary keys used for canary.
- Schedule a 2-week retrospective: share wins, surprises, and follow-up A-items.

Attachments / artifacts to keep updated:
- perf-runbook.md (link in linked_artifacts).
- eval-results.csv (weekly).
- canary-plan.md (versioned).

Signer / steward: Priya Kapoor (product-ops) — maintain this doc, own the weekly KPI snapshot.

Quick log (editing history):
- 2024-09-18 Created initial draft from notes after release planning session.
- 2024-10-02 Added KPI thresholds and quick decision matrix.
- 2024-11-13 Inserted contingency snippets and weekly cadence.
notes_summary: Working ops playbook to converge KPIs and roadmap into a release forecast. Includes thresholds, decision matrix, contingency actions, weekly cadence, and communication templates. Draft maintained by product-ops.
